product_metadata.title: 17" x 17" Large Pop up Mesh Screen Food Cover Tents，Reusable and Collapsible Outdoor Picnic Food Covers Mesh (6PCS, White)
features: BUILT TO LAST: Our food cover tents are made from highly durable Organza Net with the base stand made from zinc-plated steel wire. Additionally, each pop-up food tent is equipped with a special bottom band extension, so your food is completely covered, day or night
Easy to use and storage: The Mesh Food Covers Work like umbrella, sturdy and lightweight, extremely easy to open/close and take it anywhere.Steel Wire Frame Pops Up and Locks in Place As it Opens
Reusable and Washable: Clean the spot by wet scrubbing cloth or take off the mesh net from the umbrella frame,handwash it and air dry

FOOD COVERS FOR OUTDOORS: Umbrella design covers most large serving platters,Perfect food tent for camping, picnic, party, BBQ table cookout accessories, home and outdoor serving food tray cover; Outdoor food covers for all foods such as burgers, bbq chicken, steaks, grilled veggies, corn on the cobb, kabobs, watermelon, cantaloupe, pineapple, fruit salads
description: Please Take these food tents wherever you go, and always have them easily accessible to keep unwanted insects away from your food.  After popping into place, these food covers lock and do not collapse until you're ready to put them away. Large enough to contain a party-sized platter of food, and tall enough to shelter a good-sized pot, these food tents have you covered! Entertain with ease, Features:  Keeps food clean and safe, Dimensions is 17"x17" x 11"  Portable, foldable size, very easy to use and convenient  Good for travel and active lifestyles Perfect for any outdoor dining experience,such as Barbecues, picnics, camping trips, and pool parties, etc  Simple to spot clean and also hand washable Package Contents: - 6 x Mesh Food Covers
